Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the meaning of “founded” and prematurely concluded that the correct year was 1968 (the year VCU was created via merger) despite evidence in the surfaced official sources (e.g., VCU Bulletin snippet stating “VCU was founded in 1838...”) indicating the commonly cited founding year is 1838 (originating with MCV). This conflation of the university’s formation date with its founding led the process toward the wrong final answer.
